name: witness
description: See it. Test it. Prove it. Records only observed steps, documents them in Gherkin, and proves them with Playwright MCP.

interface.shortDescription: See it. Test it. Prove it.
interface.longDescription: Witness walks a web product, records only observed steps as JSON, documents that journey in Gherkin, and proves it with Playwright MCP. A pass requires snapshot evidence. It does not invent steps or solve captcha image puzzles.
interface.defaultPrompt: /witness:mission Make sure the main product flow works end to end.
